name: Copperline Forged Brass Heavy-Duty Compression Fitting Kit (1/2" NPT)
description: Engineered from high-density solid forged brass alloy with precision-tapered NPT threading and certified lead-free metallurgy. Designed to withstand rigorous working pressures up to 1,200 PSI and hydronic heating temperatures up to 250°F. Features a precision dual-bevel sealing ring that creates a permanent, zero-leak joint across copper, brass, and PEX plumbing lines without soldering.

name: Copperline Master-Forge Full-Port Brass Shutoff Ball Valve (3/4" NPT)
description: Heavyweight forged brass quarter-turn ball valve featuring a hard-chrome-plated solid brass ball and dual self-lubricating PTFE seats. Hydrostatically tested to 600 WOG / 150 WSP for domestic potable water, hydronic heating loops, and boiler manifold isolation. Equipped with a blowout-proof stem and heavy-duty insulated vinyl lever handle for effortless shutoff control.

name: Copperline Thermal-Flex Stainless Braided Water Heater Supply Line (3/4" FIP x 24")
description: Industrial-grade multi-filament 304 stainless steel braided connector with high-temperature santoprene inner core, designed for tankless and standard water heaters and hydronic loop systems. Features solid forged brass dielectric connector nuts and heavy-duty EPDM sealing washers to prevent galvanic corrosion and thermal expansion leaks. Rated to 200°F continuous heat and 250 PSI.
